title: VulkanizedPVP
description: This modpack is based on PVP and Vulkan rendering engine.
body:
Welcome to VulkanizedPvP, a Minecraft modpack engineered for competitive PvP players who demand maximum frame rates and zero stutter. This pack bridges the gap between next-generation Vulkan rendering and fluid combat mechanics for Minecraft 1.21.11.

Key Features
Vulkanized Optimization: Powered directly by VulkanMod instead of standard OpenGL, allowing your graphics card to handle Minecraft much more efficiently for massive FPS gains.

Advanced PvP Enhancements: Includes essential competitive utilities such as customizable hit ranges, optimized aim assistance visualizers, better hurt camera controls, and clean crosshair addons.

Infinite Horizons: Integrated with Distant Horizons and dedicated Vulkan compatibility patches, allowing you to see massive render distances without ruining your PvP performance.

Network and Logic Tweaks: Utilizing high-end performance mods to optimize server-side and client-side physics, keeping your packet processing and input lag as low as possible.

All Mods:

Clumps, BadOptimizations, LibJF, Lithium, BetterHurtCam, No Chat Reports, Cloth Config API, Visuality, Distant Horizons, HitRange, More Culling, Not Enough Vulkan, Packet Fixer, Melody, Slyde, Concurrent Chunk Management Engine (Fabric), Beryl, Zoomify (Zoom), CreamyKeys, Sound Physics Remastered, Client Sort, Distant Horizons for VulkanMod, Fadeless, Fast Noise, Fabric Language Kotlin, Fzzy Config, TotemCounter, Consumable Optimizer, Shulker Box Tooltip, Very Many Players (Fabric), Optimal Aim, FerriteCore, Shield Statuses, Simple Voice Chat, WalksyLib, ModernFix-mVUS, AppleSkin, 3D Skin Layers, Krypton, Silicon, Status Effect Timer, uku's Armor HUD, BetterGrassify, Better Ping Display [Fabric], Shield Fixes, Particle Core, Fabric API, Crosshair Addons Public, Mouse Tweaks, ukulib, Mod Menu, Combat Hitboxes, VulkanMod, Vulkan Motion Blur, Dynamic FPS, ScalableLux

All Resource Packs:

Low Fire, Mandala's GUI - Dark mode, Low Shield, CPVP Essentials (Crystal PvP)

Getting Started:
Install the modpack via the Modrinth App or your preferred third-party launcher.

Launch the profile using Minecraft version 1.21.11.

Open the in-game settings to configure your custom crosshair, shield positions, and Vulkan video settings.

Note: While this pack is designed to be compliant with multiplayer networks, always check specific server rules regarding custom HUD layouts, hit indicators, and client-side modifications.
